title: Search coverage and remaining work

definitions.query: A recorded source-specific search expression; retries and partitions are not additional planned queries.
definitions.observation: A returned record or file occurrence; repeats across queries/sources are retained.
definitions.individualReview: A documented assessment of a specified primary page, README, instruction component or selected implementation; it is not necessarily a full code audit.
definitions.canonicalUnit: A reconciled project/component identity, which can group multiple source observations.
definitions.publicCard: A published presentation unit; its total is not obtained by summing eligible source rows or component observations.

githubCode.limitation: Sharded code logs retain file-size partitions and resulting items, but omit per-page records; completion is collector-reported, not independently page-by-page verifiable. Indexed code size limit 393216 bytes; index coverage is not repository coverage.

smithery.limitation: Vocabulary-query pagination, not full unfiltered directory enumeration.

indexedDirectories.limitation: Search-engine indexed results only; no complete directory enumeration, no result-pagination exhaustion claim. Glama API unavailable without key; PulseMCP and MCP.so directory-wide access not established.

officialMCPRegistry.reviewBoundary: Live latest-version pagination, not transactionally frozen; metadata negatives were automated and not all records individually reviewed.

docker.reviewBoundary: Retained repository snapshot screened locally; files are not distinct servers and this is not live global directory enumeration.
